content: We do not include the complete results of our experiments here due to space constraints but include them along with charts and program code on our project website. Based on this exploration we find that the best weights for this particular dataset are 1 for non-propaganda and 4 for propaganda and we use this to train the final model used to submit results to the leaderboard. We also found that adding Part of Speech tags and Named Entity information to BERT embeddings by concatenating these one-hot vectors to the BERT embeddings does not improve model performance. We describe these results in Section SECREF5.
